title: UploadCompletionOutcome
description:
The terminal answer to finalize. Both variants are truthful answers at `200` in the canonical
binding: a mismatch is an anticipated fact about the bytes, not a transport fault.

oneOf.description:
The streamed digest equaled the declaration. The reference below is everything the
workspace store spec `blob-references` requires to resolve the stored bytes.

blob_ref.description: The content-addressed reference to the sealed bytes, owned by the receiving service.

oneOf.description:
The streamed digest differed from the declaration. Terminal-failed: the token is dead
afterwards, and the client restarts with a new session rather than patching chunks.

computed_sha256_hex.description: The digest the streamed bytes actually produced.

BlobRef.description:
Reference to content-addressed bytes owned by one service.

This is a reference, not a storage API. The owner writes and resolves the bytes under its own
content-addressed directory. No host, filesystem path, signed URL, credentials, or expiry can
appear in this contract.
